source.version: main snapshot reviewed 2026-07-13; no tagged release

capabilities.title: Create zero-dependency single-file HTML presentations with inline CSS and JavaScript
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Key Features and SKILL.md Core Principles
capabilities.reason: The Company Map records this optional workflow but Nexus does not yet generate or validate Frontend Slides-compatible artifacts.

capabilities.title: Generate three authentic deck-title previews so the user selects a visual direction by seeing it
capabilities.reason: Nexus has design guidance but no presentation-specific three-preview selection workflow or acceptance proof.

capabilities.title: Load compact preset indexes and preview cards before reading only the selected full design recipe
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Architecture and SKILL.md Progressive Disclosure rules
capabilities.reason: This useful context-budget pattern has not been adapted to a Nexus presentation lane.

capabilities.title: Offer safe presets, a broad bold-template pack, and a context-specific custom wildcard
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Included Styles and SKILL.md Preview mix rules
capabilities.reason: Nexus has not reviewed the full style/template inventory against its taste and licensing requirements.

capabilities.title: Author every slide at 1920 by 1080 and uniformly scale the stage across desktop and phone viewports
capabilities.reason: No Frontend Slides artifact or fixed-stage validation exists in Nexus.

capabilities.title: Include reduced-motion support, readable density limits, navigation, and accessible presentation behavior
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Production Quality and SKILL.md fixed-stage/delivery rules
capabilities.reason: A real generated artifact and accessibility acceptance pass are required before claiming this capability.

capabilities.title: Choose low-density speaker-led or high-density reading-first deck behavior
capabilities.reason: Nexus briefs do not yet compile into presentation-specific density contracts.

capabilities.title: Inspect supplied images and co-design the slide outline around usable visual evidence
capabilities.reason: No bounded presentation image-ingest and provenance workflow exists in Nexus.

capabilities.title: Extract and preserve PowerPoint text, images, order, and speaker notes before restyling to HTML
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README PPT Conversion and SKILL.md Phase 4
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not install python-pptx or expose a protected PPT conversion lane.

capabilities.title: Improve an existing HTML presentation while preserving fixed-stage fit and splitting overflow
capabilities.reason: No presentation enhancement workflow has been adapted or visually proven in Nexus.

capabilities.title: Verify overflow, overlap, desktop rendering, and a phone viewport using rendered browser screenshots
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SKILL.md modification and generation verification rules
capabilities.reason: Nexus's local browser policy currently blocks the required rendered artifact acceptance in this environment.

capabilities.title: Provide keyboard, touch, slide navigation, and in-browser text editing for generated decks
capabilities.reason: No Frontend Slides HTML runtime has been generated or tested by Nexus.

capabilities.title: Capture slides and combine them into a static PDF export
capabilities.reason: A reviewed cross-platform export tool and layout proof would be required.

capabilities.title: Deploy presentation artifacts to an external Vercel URL
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not automatically publish operator artifacts; external deployment remains a separate explicit human action.

capabilities.title: Run the core skill through Claude Code, Codex, and other filesystem-capable coding agents
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README Installation and Other Coding Agents
capabilities.reason: The Company Map records the Codex path but intentionally does not install the external skill.
